title: [PROPOSED] WP1308 recovery: adopted approved_pending lease rebind
body:
Proposed private-preparation prerequisite for WP1308 readmission. This Issue is not a lease, implementation activation, new target grant, human audit or acceptance.

Public canonical baseline: c0b8e11d7099f756e65db8bd9a81493cde789a6f.
Static code inspection shows that _1174_adopt_payload preserves approved_pending but clears scoped_review; _1174_record_lease permits adopted lease rebind only from leased/running/reviewing. approved_pending has no ordinary transition out; a new review requires reviewing and accept requires a scoped review. A direct adoption-plus-rebind continuation needs a reviewed design correction.

Proposed first phase only: prepare a private minimal correction, focused Linux regression evidence and immutable candidate handoff after exact material approval/registration/lease. Preserve all prior counters, histories, immutable source snapshots, call consumption, fencing and paired witness high_water. No fresh-init over existing state, manual journal/witness edit, fabricated finding to reopen, stale proof, generic transition escape or deadline bypass.

Expected worker scope is packet_loop.py, packet_loop_test.py and a packet-specific recovery design note. No code/H push, source PR, GitHub CI, Windows/fullM9, independent reviewer/connector dispatch, merge/activation or g5 target grant belongs to this preparation phase. Actual-human audit remains mandatory for later publication/acceptance. Further source/target execution remains blocked until separately applicable gates and authority are satisfied.

This public planning payload intentionally excludes private runtime paths, boot identities, state/witness hashes, seeds, HMAC material and raw operational logs. Any precise Mission/Packet authority will be linked only after its actual approval and readback.
